Subject: Offer of employment as Software Engineer II

We are excited to offer you the role of Software Engineer II at Northwind Labs. You will work from our Bengaluru office.

Basic: Rs. 7,20,000 per annum
HRA: Rs. 3,60,000 per annum

You will also be granted 2,000 stock options under the Northwind ESOP plan, vesting over four years.
PF is calculated on the statutory wage ceiling of Rs. 15,000 per month.
Variable pay is subject to company and individual performance and is paid at the sole discretion of the company.
You shall not take up any other employment or freelance work without prior written consent from the company.
Your probation period is 3 months.
The notice period is 60 days for both parties.
